formal_return_interface.verdict_warning: These are future eligibility predicates, not values assigned to any future review now. Only the actual fresh independent reviewer may issue the return.
formal_return_interface.packet_semantics: packet_id identifies the actual review assignment; it need not equal the author/source packet. Canonical example review packetf2eced... differs from author manifest packeta3c0cf.... For final06 add explicit source_packet_id as above, while preserving the actual review packet_id. Check it against the candidate manifest packet_id. Do not invent a new review packet or silently equate independent assignments.
formal_return_interface.candidate_identity: Exactly sha256: followed by SHA256 of the actual frozen candidate ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json bytes. The canonical repair04 manifest digest is d796c9df... and is the formal candidate identity. Do not hash reserialized JSON or insert a self-hash into the manifest.
formal_return_interface.publication_export_identity: For the proposed small-export interface below, the fresh reviewer additionally records publication_export_identity=sha256:<actual PUBLICATION_EXPORT.json byte hash>. That packaging identity is distinct from the scientific candidate identity.
other_semantic_checks: agent_id must identify the actual independent reviewer, different from the source author and contributing science framers; requested and observed runtime stay separate. Bind the raw receipt and its SHA.
findings=[] is accepted. Nonempty findings require explicit structured resolution/nonblocking classification from that reviewer; unknown or unresolved substantive findings remain HOLD.
phase is optional; when present it must be review. A status-word substring or a narrative PASS is never sufficient.
Final source manifest/RESULT may retain proposed status and acceptance_met=false as frozen author evidence. Qualification comes from the separately bound formal return; do not rewrite source status.
Exact source task, input, candidate, source packet, qualified product and export identity are all checked together. Review of a different candidate or product does not qualify this export.

candidate_manifest_interface.entry_semantics: candidate_files is an object keyed by logical filename; source_bindings is an object keyed by original source identity/path. Each entry has path,sha256,bytes. The repair04 example uses bytes, not size_bytes. Row.source retains its existing size_bytes field; do not rewrite it to match the manifest.

publication_export_interface.roles: roles is a JSON object. result,observed_row,mask_response_json,mask_response_npz,raw_input_inventory,observed_replay_parity,observed_replay_run,scientific_contract,source_scope_note each map to one existing files key. mc_rows is an ordered100-element list of files keys for IDs0300..0399. source_receipts is a list of files keys covering actual per-product verified/acquisition/header evidence. No basename inference.
publication_export_interface.raw_inputs_policy: METADATA_AND_REVIEWED_RECEIPTS_ONLY; raw FITS retained externally; raw_source_replay_requires_external_inputs; CACHED_PUBLICATION_REBUILD does not reopen maps.
freeze_order: Freeze all required small evidence and canonical candidate manifest first.

Create the export index mapping those exact files and the unchanged manifest copy. Every exported scientific file must match a canonical candidate_files/source_bindings entry; the index is packaging metadata outside the self-hash of that manifest.

Fresh source reviewer reviews exact candidate and export index, then issues formal return with both identities. Do not include the future formal return hash inside the export index or create a self-referential hash cycle.

Place the actual formal return beside the export. P2 FINAL_SOURCE_BINDING.json binds actual manifest,candidate,export-index and formal-return hashes/paths and selected observed replay receipts. These final values remain pending until real artifacts/review exist.
publication_export_interface.validation: Resolve relative paths within the export root, check exact sizes/hashes and original-entry equality, then evaluate the structured formal gate and all fixed100/operator/statistic/CP checks from the frozen editor contract. Do not follow embedded absolute raw paths during cached publication rebuild. Preserve exact JSON payload bytes; relocation is described by the index, not by rewriting frozen receipts.
failure_classes: Missing or mismatched small payload: EXPORT_BINDING_HOLD.
Unavailable external FITS during paper rebuild alone: RAW_SOURCE_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE, not an automatic paper-build or scientific-integrity failure.
Present but unreviewed future-number slots: PENDING_SOURCE_QUALIFICATION; no public-ready rendering.
publication_export_interface.files_container: files is a JSON object keyed by unique stable export IDs, e.g. result,observed_row,mc_0300,verified_0300,acquire_0300. Every value has exactly the fields described in files_entry_shape; manifest_key/original_path preserve canonical source identity while relative_path locates the copy.
publication_export_interface.final_binding_additions: Alongside the existing pending fields in5acd, FINAL_SOURCE_BINDING explicitly records publication_export_path,publication_export_sha256,source_packet_id,review_packet_id. Its source_candidate_manifest_path points to the unchanged exported manifest copy; formal_source_return_path points to the actual reviewer return. qualified_result_path and qualified_observed_replay_row_path resolve to the corresponding exported copies, whose original paths/hashes are retained in the index.
